critical_issues.issue: Generated application use cases depended directly on infrastructure repositories, violating Clean Architecture.
critical_issues.fix: Refactored code generation to emit domain repository ports and keep infrastructure wiring inside the presentation/infrastructure boundary.

critical_issues.issue: Technical filesystem scanning logic lived inside the domain layer.
critical_issues.fix: Moved security scanning and refactor analysis into infrastructure adapters and reduced domain services to business architecture rules only.

critical_issues.issue: The orchestrator executed steps without timeout or retry controls, making failures non-isolated and unsafe for production workloads.
critical_issues.fix: Added step-level retries, backoff, timeout enforcement, missing-agent protection and asynchronous repository persistence.

high_priority.issue: Blocking subprocess and IO calls inside async agents could stall the event loop.
high_priority.fix: Moved QA, Git, backend file writes and analysis tasks to worker threads via asyncio.to_thread.

high_priority.issue: File generation was not diff-aware or idempotent.
high_priority.fix: Enhanced the file manager to classify created, updated and unchanged files and avoid rewriting identical content.

high_priority.issue: LLM handling lacked sanitization, timeouts and resilience under repeated provider failures.
high_priority.fix: Added response sanitization, request timeouts, schema validation retries and a circuit breaker in the structured LLM service.

medium_priority.issue: Agent registration was assembled ad hoc, making pluggability weaker than required.
medium_priority.fix: Introduced an application-level agent registry and explicit ports for agents, pipeline loading and execution persistence.

medium_priority.issue: Per-agent lifecycle logs were emitted but not fully attached to agent results.
medium_priority.fix: Centralized log collection inside BaseAgent so lifecycle hooks propagate structured logs consistently.

medium_priority.issue: The API ignored per-request provider selection and retained more process state than necessary.
medium_priority.fix: Changed the FastAPI run endpoint to build the orchestrator per request provider, improving statelessness and horizontal scaling readiness.
